globe_usher.text: Welcome to the Globe. Mind the groundlings, they stand in the yard and have the best view and the worst knees.
The first Globe opened in 1599. It burned down in 1613 when a cannon fired in a play set the thatch alight.
This one opened in 1997, rebuilt near the original. It has the first thatched roof in London since the Great Fire of 1666.

globe_actor.text: All the world is a stage, and this is the part of the world with the good acoustics.
No microphones. We shout. Some of us were born for it.

london_quizmaster.text: Order, order! The quiz at the Globe is about to begin. Please keep the tragedy to a minimum and the groundlings to the left.
Five questions. Phones away, please. Dave, I can hear that one buzzing through your trousers, and so can the actors.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Parting is such sweet sorrow. Do come back.
